text: V5.0M — the best draw on the board. Spend it like it's the last money you'll see; the league won't be gentle.
We drew V1.2M. Enough for a manager, a hard-working squad and one good building — not all three done well. Choose.
V3.2M. You can have two of the three done well. The third decides your season.
Right then. Every club needs one voice on the training pitch. Spend on a manager first — the rest waits on him.
Still no manager? Even a modest one beats none.
He'll do a job. He won't win you the league.
A steady hand. Now give him a squad that matches his style.
That's a manager who carries out a brief. Now build him a team.
Out of pocket? Sell a player or take the board advance — nobody's stuck here.
A manager needs a bench. Sign a legal matchday squad — eleven, and one of them a keeper.
Short of eleven. The league won't let us play, and PLAY will say so.
Legal. Now make it balanced.
A proper shape. That's a side that can win a friendly.
Balanced, honest and paid for. That's how you survive year one.
Sell the luxury, keep the spine. We can rebuild in January.
Now build one thing that makes the next thing cheaper. Training if you'll buy young; Stands if you'll be broke.
A Tier-1 stand pays the gate fee every match.
Foundation laid. Now make the next thing cheaper.
The right building. It compounds.
Foundation laid and money left over. That's an owner's build.
Too dear this month? The cheapest Tier-1 still counts for the step.
One hundred XP stands between you and a real league. Wins pay 30. You need them.
Wins are the only thing that move the Level bar now.
Level 1. You're in.
Level 1, and a build to be proud of.
Level 1. Your league has a name now — and so do your rivals.
Safe start: any qualifying friendly pays the same XP on the way up.
An interview costs V25k. It tells you exactly what you're buying. Skip it and you're guessing.
That wage eats the budget. A cheaper voice leaves money for players.
No keeper, no match. Sort the gloves first.
The cheapest legal XI is beyond us. Scout, sell, or take the board advance.
A Tier-1 stand pays the gate fee every match.
The cheapest Tier-1 still counts for the step.
No training ground yet. It compounds every young player you sign.
Can't play yet — you need a manager and a legal XI.
Funds are low. The board can advance you a loan for a fee.
First manager through the door. Onwards.
You've been at this a while. The club will keep.
You've done this before. I'll keep quiet unless you need me.
